<!-- The name lists below are generated from Authors@R in the package DESCRIPTION (the single source of truth), in DESCRIPTION order. Edit names, roles, and order there, not here. -->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Read Authors@R from the source DESCRIPTION (walking up from the article's directory); fall back to the installed package.
find_description <- function() {
  d <- normalizePath(getwd())
  repeat {
    f <- file.path(d, "DESCRIPTION")
    if (file.exists(f) && identical(unname(read.dcf(f, fields = "Package")[1, 1]), "growthcleanr")) return(f)
    parent <- dirname(d)
    if (parent == d) return(system.file("DESCRIPTION", package = "growthcleanr"))
    d <- parent
  }
}
people <- eval(parse(text = read.dcf(find_description(), fields = "Authors@R")[1, 1]))
list_role <- function(role) {
  keep <- vapply(people, function(p) role %in% p$role, logical(1))
  names <- vapply(people[keep], function(p) paste(c(p$given, p$family), collapse = " "), character(1))
  cat(paste0("- ", names), sep = "\n")
}
```

## Maintainer and authors

Carrie Daymont developed and maintains the child and adult algorithms. Other authors implemented the algorithm in R (converting it from its initial implementation in Stata statistical software), added associated utility functions, and developed the Shiny app.

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
list_role("aut")
```

## Other contributors

Those listed below contributed documentation, smaller amounts of code, domain input (including statistical expertise to support validation), background research, and/or administrative support. Contributors are listed alphabetically.

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
list_role("ctb")
```

## Scientific advisors (clinician experts)

The physicians listed below provided clinical expertise to validate growthcleanr or to inform its design. The two pediatricians who performed the initial validation are listed first, and others are listed alphabetically.

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
list_role("sad")
```

## Funding and organizations

The current release of growthcleanr was funded by the HHS Office of the Secretary Patient-Centered Outcomes Research Trust Fund (OS-PCORTF) and supported by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Division of Nutrition, Physical Activity, and Obesity. Original development of growthcleanr was supported in large part by the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) Pediatric Research in Office Settings (PROS) network, including with data provided by the AAP PROS Comparative Effectiveness Research through Collaborative Electronic Reporting (CER^2^) electronic health record data network. The Children's Hospital of Philadelphia contributed data and programming support. The University of Manitoba and Penn State College of Medicine provided salary support, and Penn State Health Golisano Children's Hospital contributed data.
